evals.name: triggers-on-chiptune-loop
evals.prompt: compose a short gameboy chiptune loop, calm, and give me a wav
evals.expected_output: Fires /retro-audio:music. Writes an MML score within four parts and one noise part, renders it with the mml command --chip gameboy, and delivers the WAV path and the score.
expectations: Invokes the music skill, not sfx
Renders a WAV with mml.py and keeps the score text

evals.name: pasted-mml-is-rendered
evals.prompt: render this MML to wav on the NES chip: t140 o4 l8 c e g > c
evals.expected_output: Fires /retro-audio:music. Passes the user's score through mml.py with --chip nes rather than rewriting it into a different melody. Delivers the WAV.
expectations: Uses the nes chip because the user named it

evals.name: near-miss-one-shot-routes-to-sfx
evals.prompt: I need a pickup sound effect, not a song
evals.expected_output: Does not fire /retro-audio:music. A one-shot effect is /retro-audio:sfx. Routes there instead of scoring a loop.
expectations: Does not invoke the music skill for a one-shot effect
